leadStory: Liverpool make an initial approach to Monaco for the France winger Maghnes Akliouche, valued near £42.6m, the first deliverable heir to Salah's vacated right flank after Bradley Barcola was priced out at £127.5m.
subject: A lone footballer standing on the far wing of an empty floodlit pitch at dusk, small in a wide frame, the space around him unfilled
